answer.reason: The mutant gives the fork a one-shot generator instead of a tuple of copied turns. After the fork's history is read once it is empty, so later requests lose remembered turns. The copying is also deferred, so the fork is not an independent snapshot. Both break the requirement that forks keep their history and diverge independently.
